rules.title: Residential Tenant Protections (Tenants' Right to Know Regulations), San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 9, Article 8, Division 7
rules.requirement: A landlord may not terminate a tenancy without just cause, either at-fault (e.g., nonpayment, breach, nuisance) or no-fault (owner move-in, withdrawal from market, government order, demolition or substantial remodel). No-fault terminations carry notice content requirements, re-rental offers and relocation duties; landlords must also give tenants a written notice of protections and a Tenant Protection Guide.
rules.key_value: Owner move-in requires occupancy within 90 days for at least 12 continuous months; substantial remodel requires vacating at least 30 continuous days
rules.status_basis: Added 5-25-2023 by O-21647 N.S.; effective 6-24-2023; amended 2-27-2024 by O-21769 N.S., effective 3-28-2024.

exempt_if.text: housing that has been issued a certificate of occupancy within the previous 15 years, unless the housing is a mobilehome
residential rental property that is alienable separate from the title to any other dwelling unit

exempt_if.name: landlord_not_REIT_corporation_LLC_with_corporate_member_and_notice_given
exempt_if.text: landlord is not a REIT, corporation, or LLC with a corporate member, and tenants were given written exemption notice
a property containing two separate dwelling units within a single structure in which the landlord occupies one as principal residence

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: landlord occupies one unit as principal residence at beginning of tenancy and continues in occupancy
single-family residence occupied by the landlord as principal place of residence, renting no more than two bedrooms or two ADUs/JADUs

exempt_if.name: owner_occupied
exempt_if.text: occupied by the landlord as principal place of residence

exempt_if.name: special_housing_types
exempt_if.text: transient/tourist hotels, short-term occupancy, deed-restricted or subsidized affordable housing (not Section 8), mobilehomes under the Mobilehome Residency Law, nonprofit hospitals, religious facilities, care facilities, transitional housing, and dormitories

coverage.summary: Applies to residential rental tenancies of more than 30 days in San Diego unless exempt.
coverage.exemptions_summary: Exempts hotels, short-term occupancy, affordable and subsidized housing, mobilehomes, care facilities, dormitories, shared-space owner-occupied housing, owner-occupied single-family or duplex properties, housing with a certificate of occupancy within 15 years, and separately alienable units with non-corporate landlords who gave notice.

precedence.text: The rights conferred by this Division are in addition to any existing rights provided to tenants by state or federal law.

rules.quoted_span: A landlord shall not terminate a tenancy without just cause. For purposes of this Division, just cause includes at-fault just cause and no-fault just cause.
